basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old gamer from Texas, passionate about PC gaming and always looking for new friends to play with. I play a variety of games including Risk of Rain 2, Minecraft, and Rust, but I'm open to trying new games as well. I work as an IT technician, which allows me to have flexible hours, and I'm usually online at random times throughout the day. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time gaming, exploring new music, and building LEGO sets. I love helping new gamers get started and am always up for a friendly challenge.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in technology, having studied computer science in college and working in IT for several years. I am mostly self-taught when it comes to gaming, having started with basic games in my childhood and gradually exploring more complex ones. My love for music stems from playing guitar in a band during my college years.
